Photo 0 shows dirt/rust spotting and paint wear on the frame, inconsistent with 'neatly' kept.

risks.proof: Close-up video of brakes engaging and gear shifting (if geared) in motion
Close-up photo of chain and underside of frame
Close-up photo of tire tread and sidewalls
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn tires needing replacement

risks.risk: Hidden frame damage/dents not visible from side angle
risks.proof: Photos from front, rear, and top-down angles
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible undisclosed damage

risks.proof: Video of wheels spinning freely to check wobble
Seller statement with purchase date or receipt, or serial number photo

risks.risk: Pedals and reflectors may be missing or broken
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both pedals and all reflectors
Photo/video of seat height adjustment mechanism in use

proof_requests: Close-up video of brakes and gears in operation
Close-up photos of chain, tire tread, and both pedals
Photos from front, rear, and top-down angles to check for frame damage
Video of wheels spinning to check truing
Photo of any serial number or purchase receipt for age verification
response.reason: The witness clearly identified the item as a children's bicycle, so it can be priced at worst case given visible wear and unverified mechanical condition, pending further proof to raise the price.
